objective: Independently issue one terminal mechanism-family disposition for two sealed pre-2025 DRA capital-release and rebalancing studies: flat-veto cooldown route substitution V2B and one-slot profitable-incumbent signal rotation V1. Compare only within-study parent/candidate pairs and compare failure shapes across studies; never rank absolute PnL across their different capital, parent and accounting contracts. Decide whether this family should remain closed because causal/accounting repairs failed validation risk-adjusted economics, retain at most one later separately frozen audit because a sealed selected candidate satisfies its own validation PnL, drawdown, holding and breadth gates, or stop for integrity insufficiency. Do not rerun either study, tune rescue parameters, open OOS, create a hypothesis or candidate, alter DRA runtime, or perform Trading actions.

inputs.locator: For flat-veto V2B inspect only sealed identity, data quality, contamination, OOS, status, qualified/selected candidate, validation router_v2 versus router_v2b, 2022 paired rows and frozen gates. The causal 2022 route-substitution repair is not equivalent to whole-Validation economic improvement.

For one-slot rotation inspect only sealed identity, data quality, contamination, OOS, status, qualified/selected candidate, parent versus candidate Validation, frozen gates and annual total/drawdown breadth. Total-PnL uplift from terminal-inventory cleanup is not automatically realized alpha.

The family label is DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_REBALANCING. It covers only attempts to free blocked capacity by route-substitution cooldown or profitable-incumbent rotation. It excludes post-shock, carry, volatility management, CFTC positioning, microstructure, range sleeves and any live runtime change.

stop_conditions: Validate this exact task and every non-null SHA-256 before analysis; any mismatch, missing input, link, reparse point, duplicate locator, wrong type, dirty worktree or HEAD/origin drift is BLOCKED and MISSING_PROOF.

Use only the three repository contracts, two exact sealed diagnostics and three task messages listed here. Do not access conversation history, canonical/server state, other .research-state files, forward evidence, OOS, prices, raw market corpus or Trading data.

Both diagnostics must have exact frozen hashes, research-only authorization, PASS data quality and baseline parity, POST_HOC_HISTORICAL_NO_CLEAN_OOS contamination, oos_opened=false, qualified_count=0, selected_candidate=null and terminal NO_CANDIDATE status. Any identity or integrity failure returns DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_INSUFFICIENT.

Compare values only inside each diagnostic's own parent/candidate pair. The flat-veto router uses 250 USDT reference capital while one-slot rotation uses 30 USDT; never compare or add their absolute PnL, drawdown, turnover, utilization or holdings across studies.

For flat-veto V2B, distinguish the real 2022 route-substitution repair from whole-Validation economics. A lower 2022 loss/drawdown does not retain the family if Validation total PnL is lower, drawdown is higher or frozen validation economic gates fail.

For one-slot rotation, separate realized, unrealized and terminal inventory. A higher Validation total does not retain the family if realized PnL is not strictly higher, drawdown or median holding is worse, or annual drawdown non-worse breadth fails its frozen gate.

Return DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_REBALANCING_BRANCH_CLOSE if both exact studies have zero qualified candidates and their causal/accounting improvements fail their own frozen Validation risk-adjusted gates. Do not tune 168h, 60 USDT, rotation thresholds or any rescue variant.

Return DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_RETAIN_ONE_FUTURE_AUDIT only if at least one exact sealed study has a selected qualified candidate and passes its own Validation total, realized, drawdown, holding, terminal-inventory and annual-breadth gates. This can authorize only one separately frozen later audit, not a candidate or OOS.

Keep forward predictive value, clean OOS, deployment value and all unlisted risk metrics MISSING_PROOF. Preserve exact historical PnL/drawdown/holding values only as sealed diagnostics, not future expectations.

Return exactly one of DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_RETAIN_ONE_FUTURE_AUDIT, DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_REBALANCING_BRANCH_CLOSE, or DRA_CAPITAL_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_INSUFFICIENT. Make no file changes and return exactly one task-hash-bound local-research-result JSON with empty artifacts/files_changed and all safety assertions false.
